history.summary: Ancient Devi temple in the village of Bundla, ~3-4 km from Palampur market, locally famous as the Vindhyavasini (Bundla Mata) temple and highly revered by Palampur locals. The simple stone-and-wood structure sits amid tea gardens with the Dhauladhar range as backdrop and a stream cascading close by; it is administered by the Juna Akhara according to one source. Pilgrims often combine a visit with the nearby Jakhni Mata temple. Founding date is UNVERIFIED (verify); sources only document its long-standing local prominence.

name: Bundlamata Temple
town_description: Bundla is a small hamlet just outside Palampur in Kangra district, Himachal Pradesh, set among tea gardens with views of the snow-capped Dhauladhar range. A stream flows near the village, and the Bundla Mata (Vindhyavasini) temple is its main landmark. It lies ~3-4 km from the Palampur bus stand, with local buses and cabs connecting the two. CSV town 'Palampur' corrected: the temple is at Bundla village, not in Palampur town itself.

travel.road: ~3-4 km from Palampur bus stand; local buses (e.g. 6:24 AM, 8:45 AM from Palampur) drop visitors in front of the temple; scenic road through tea gardens
